investigation_notes.Description: A large volume of SharePoint downloads (294 files vs 24h baseline of 25) was observed from acc_svc@globalcorp.ee targeting the DACH_Finance_Central site, with files appearing to be financial and payroll records. The activity originated from an Endla Datacenter IP in Tallinn using an automated WinHttpRequest user agent and the Workday MSGraph application, and both source and destination IPs have no malicious reputation and there are no recent similar alerts. Given the automated application context, hosting-provider source, and lack of negative reputation or prior alerts, this is assessed as Low Priority but the volume and sensitive file types warrant validation of the account/service owner with the finance team.
